items.title: 中信证券：AI+能化可能是今年更合适的杠铃结构
items.raw_excerpt: 36氪获悉，中信证券研报表示，AI+能化可能是今年更合适的杠铃结构。今年的AI+能化，或与2023-2024年的AI+红利、2025年的AI+资源类似，有望在全年维度上，成为主要的供需缺口和超额收益来源。配置上，底层逻辑依然是中国优势制造业定价权的重估，最具代表性的行业是新能源、化工、有色、电力设备；继续密切关注国产AI的进展，硬件侧“量”的逻辑爆发仍然是目前AI链条上预期差较大的方向，而国产模型的进步有望推动云服务量价齐升，看好国产算力、云平台。

title_i18n.zh: 中信证券：AI+能化可能是今年更合适的杠铃结构
title_i18n.en: CITIC Securities: AI + Energy & Chemicals may be a more suitable barbell structure this year.

excerpt_i18n.zh: 36氪获悉，中信证券研报表示，AI+能化可能是今年更合适的杠铃结构。今年的AI+能化，或与2023-2024年的AI+红利、2025年的AI+资源类似，有望在全年维度上，成为主要的供需缺口和超额收益来源。配置上，底层逻辑依然是中国优势制造业定价权的重估，最具代表性的行业是新能源、化工、有色、电力设备；继续密切关注国产AI的进展，硬件侧“量”的逻辑爆发仍然是目前AI链条上预期差较大的方向，而国产模型的进步有望推动云服务量价齐升，看好国产算力、云平台。
excerpt_i18n.en: 36Kr has learned that a research report from CITIC Securities suggests that "AI + Energy & Chemicals" may be a more suitable barbell structure this year. Similar to "AI + Dividends" in 2023-2024 and "AI + Resources" in 2025, "AI + Energy & Chemicals" this year is expected to become a major source of supply-demand gaps and excess returns on a full-year basis. In terms of allocation, the underlying logic remains the revaluation of China's competitive manufacturing pricing power, with the most representative industries being new energy, chemicals, non-ferrous metals, and power equipment. Continued close attention should be paid to the progress of domestic AI. The explosive growth of hardware-side "volume" logic remains a direction with significant expectation gaps in the current AI chain, while advancements in domestic models are expected to drive simultaneous increases in cloud service volume and pricing. Domestic computing power and cloud platforms are viewed favorably.

items.title: PCB钻针量价齐升
items.raw_excerpt: AI PCB高景气及技术迭代，带动其生产耗材钻针的消耗量飙升、价格上涨，相关上市公司大举扩产。记者多方采访获悉，PCB钻针是AI硬件产业链上众多“长尾瓶颈”之一，其战略重要性正在上升，高端钻针正处于量价齐升通道。“这一两年，钻针市场供应仍将较为紧俏。”有A股上市公司相关负责人向记者坦言，目前扩产节奏未追上旺盛的市场需求。除受益AI带动之外，其他产业链的整体需求也起来了，包括汽车、通讯等。（财联社）

title_i18n.zh: PCB钻针量价齐升
title_i18n.en: PCB drill bit volume and price both increased.
title_i18n.es: Los taladros para PCB aumentan en cantidad y precio.

excerpt_i18n.zh: AI PCB高景气及技术迭代，带动其生产耗材钻针的消耗量飙升、价格上涨，相关上市公司大举扩产。记者多方采访获悉，PCB钻针是AI硬件产业链上众多“长尾瓶颈”之一，其战略重要性正在上升，高端钻针正处于量价齐升通道。“这一两年，钻针市场供应仍将较为紧俏。”有A股上市公司相关负责人向记者坦言，目前扩产节奏未追上旺盛的市场需求。除受益AI带动之外，其他产业链的整体需求也起来了，包括汽车、通讯等。（财联社）
excerpt_i18n.en: The high prosperity and technological iteration of AI PCBs have driven a surge in consumption and price increases for drill bits, a key production consumable, prompting related listed companies to ramp up production. Through multiple interviews, reporters learned that PCB drill bits are one of the many "long-tail bottlenecks" in the AI hardware supply chain, with their strategic importance rising, and high-end drill bits are experiencing simultaneous growth in volume and price. "The drill bit market supply will remain relatively tight over the next year or two," a relevant executive from an A-share listed company told reporters, noting that the pace of capacity expansion has yet to catch up with robust market demand. Beyond the boost from AI, overall demand from other industrial chains, including automotive and communications, has also picked up. (Cailianshe)
excerpt_i18n.es: El alto ciclo de auge del PCB para IA y la iteración tecnológica han impulsado un aumento en el consumo de sus brocas consumibles, así como una subida de precios, lo que ha llevado a las empresas cotizadas relevantes a expandir la producción de manera significativa. Según entrevistas realizadas por este medio, las brocas para PCB son uno de los muchos "cuellos de botella largos" en la cadena industrial del hardware de IA, y su importancia estratégica está aumentando, con las brocas de alta gama experimentando un aumento simultáneo en volumen y precio. "En estos uno o dos años, la oferta en el mercado de brocas seguirá siendo relativamente ajustada", comentó un responsable de una empresa cotizada en A-shares a este medio, señalando que el ritmo actual de expansión de la producción no ha logrado alcanzar la fuerte demanda del mercado. Además del impulso de la IA, la demanda general de otras cadenas industriales, incluyendo automoción y comunicaciones, también ha aumentado. (Cailianshe)
